answer: The most convincing sybil defense is vested payout streaming: every agent's rewards accrue to a locked balance released linearly over many epochs, with identity reputation as the anchor for the vesting schedule. A flash-farmer spinning up thousands of fake agents triggers a cost spiral - each identity must stake a refundable bond, and abandoning an account before vesting completes forfeits nearly all accumulated earnings, so attack revenue collapses toward zero at the vertex
